name: Predicate-final word order
meaning: Japanese normally places the predicate at the end of a clause.

name: Topic-comment structure
meaning: A sentence commonly introduces a topic and then comments on it.

name: Contextual omission
meaning: Subjects, objects, and other understood information are often omitted.

name: Modifiers precede nouns
meaning: Words and clauses that describe a noun come before that noun.

name: Relative clauses
meaning: A plain-form clause can directly modify a noun without a relative pronoun.

name: Plain and polite register
meaning: Predicates use different endings according to the required level of politeness.

name: Non-past tense
meaning: One form covers present habits, general truths, and future events.

name: Predicate types
meaning: Nouns, adjectives, and verbs have related but distinct predicate forms.

name: Plain and polite copula
meaning: State that something is or equals something.

pattern: じゃない / ではない
name: Plain negative copula
meaning: State that something is not something in plain style.

pattern: じゃありません / ではありません
name: Polite negative copula
meaning: State politely that something is not something.

name: Past copula
meaning: State that something was something.

pattern: じゃなかった / ではありませんでした
name: Past negative copula
meaning: State that something was not something.

name: Connecting noun predicates
meaning: Use the connective form of the copula to join noun descriptions.

name: Topic marker
meaning: Mark what the sentence is about.

name: Contrast marker
meaning: Contrast one topic, time, place, or choice with another.

name: Subject marker
meaning: Mark the grammatical subject, especially new or focused information.

name: Identification and exhaustive focus
meaning: Identify which person or thing satisfies a description or question.

name: Direct object marker
meaning: Mark the direct object of an action.

name: Route marker
meaning: Mark a place traversed, left, or passed through.

name: Specific time marker
meaning: Mark the specific time at which an event occurs.

name: Destination marker
meaning: Mark the destination or arrival point of movement.

name: Existence location marker
meaning: Mark the place where someone or something exists.

name: Target and recipient marker
meaning: Mark a person or thing toward which an action is directed.

name: Movement purpose marker
meaning: Mark the purpose of going, coming, or returning.

name: Frequency per period
meaning: Relate a number of occurrences to a period of time.

name: Direction marker
meaning: Mark the direction toward which someone or something moves.

name: Action location marker
meaning: Mark the place where an action or event occurs.

name: Means and instrument marker
meaning: Mark the tool, method, language, material, or transport used.

name: Complete noun listing
meaning: Join nouns as a complete list with and.

name: Companion marker
meaning: Mark the person with whom an action is done.

name: Quotation marker
meaning: Mark quoted speech, thoughts, names, and other quoted content.

name: Incomplete noun listing
meaning: Give representative examples from a larger list.

name: Possession and noun modification
meaning: Relate one noun to another through possession, type, origin, or description.

name: Noun omission with の
meaning: Replace an understood noun with の after a modifier.

name: Also and too
meaning: Add another item that shares the same statement.

name: Emphatic も
meaning: Emphasize that a quantity is as much, as many, or as long as stated.

name: Question marker
meaning: Turn a polite statement into a question.

pattern: A か B / A か B か
name: Alternative marker
meaning: Present alternatives with or.

name: Informing and emphasis
meaning: Present information the speaker wants the listener to notice.

name: Agreement and confirmation
meaning: Invite agreement or acknowledge shared information.

name: Emphatic confirmation
meaning: Assert information while asking the listener to confirm it.

name: Reflection and admiration
meaning: Express reflection, emotion, or a wish for confirmation in casual speech.

name: Starting point
meaning: Mark where or when a range or movement begins.

name: End point and limit
meaning: Mark the end of a spatial, temporal, or other range.

name: Reason with から
meaning: Give a direct reason or cause with because or since.

name: Reason with ので
meaning: Give a comparatively explanatory or softer reason.

name: Contrast with が
meaning: Join clauses with but or although, often politely.

pattern: けど / けれど / けれども
name: Contrast with けど
meaning: Join clauses with but or although in neutral or conversational speech.

name: However
meaning: Begin a contrasting sentence with but or however.

name: Formal however
meaning: Introduce a contrast with however in a more formal register.

name: And then
meaning: Add a related fact or continue a sequence.

name: After that
meaning: Continue with the next event or item in a sequence.

name: Additive reasons
meaning: List non-exhaustive reasons or related qualities with and also or besides.

name: Only
meaning: Limit something to only or just the marked item or amount.

name: Nothing but
meaning: Express that there is no more than the marked item or amount.

name: Approximate amount
meaning: Express an approximate quantity, duration, or degree.

name: Approximate time
meaning: Express approximately when something happens.

name: Examples and so on
meaning: Mark examples with such as or and so on.

name: Casual examples and reaction
meaning: Give casual examples or express dismissal, surprise, or emphasis.

name: Casual quotation
meaning: Mark quoted or topical content in casual speech.

name: Even or something like
meaning: Mark an illustrative suggestion or emphasize an unexpected example with even.

name: Honorific prefix
meaning: Add a conventional polite or respectful prefix to selected Japanese and Sino-Japanese words.

name: Verb groups
meaning: Classify verbs so their stems and conjugated forms can be predicted.

name: Ichidan verb conjugation
meaning: Conjugate most ichidan verbs by replacing the final る.

name: Godan verb conjugation
meaning: Conjugate godan verbs by shifting the final kana within its consonant row.

name: Irregular verbs
meaning: Learn the core irregular conjugations of する and 来る.

name: Verb stem
meaning: Form the conjunctive stem used before ます and several other patterns.

name: Plain non-past verbs
meaning: Express present habits, general facts, and future actions in plain style.

name: Polite non-past verbs
meaning: Express non-past actions politely.

name: Plain negative verbs
meaning: Express that an action does not or will not happen in plain style.

name: Polite negative verbs
meaning: Express that an action does not or will not happen politely.

name: Plain past verbs
meaning: Express a completed or past action in plain style.

name: Polite past verbs
meaning: Express a completed or past action politely.

name: Plain past-negative verbs
meaning: Express that an action did not happen in plain style.

name: Polite past-negative verbs
meaning: Express politely that an action did not happen.

name: Te-form
meaning: Build the central connective verb form used by many beginner patterns.

name: Linking actions with て
meaning: Connect actions or present them in sequence.

name: Ongoing action
meaning: Express an action currently in progress.

name: Resulting state and repeated action
meaning: Express a continuing result, current state, occupation, or habitual repetition.

name: Intentional resulting state
meaning: Describe the present result of an intentional action performed on something.

name: Negative progressive or state
meaning: Negate an ongoing action or continuing state.

name: Not yet
meaning: Express that an expected action has not happened yet.

name: After doing
meaning: State that one action happens after another is completed.

name: Polite request
meaning: Ask someone politely to do something.

name: Please give me
meaning: Request a thing politely.

name: Polite negative request
meaning: Ask someone politely not to do something.

name: Without doing
meaning: Do one action without doing another.

name: Permission
meaning: Say that doing something is allowed or acceptable.

name: Lack of obligation
meaning: Say that someone does not have to do something.

pattern: ～てはいけない / ～てはいけません
name: Prohibition
meaning: Say that an action must not be done.

pattern: ～ちゃいけない / ～じゃいけない
name: Casual prohibition
meaning: Forbid an action using the spoken contraction of てはいけない.

name: Direct prohibition
meaning: Tell someone directly not to do something.

name: Want to do
meaning: Express the speaker's desire to perform an action.

name: Invitation
meaning: Invite someone politely with won't you or would you like to.

name: Let's
meaning: Suggest doing an action together.

name: Offer or joint suggestion
meaning: Offer to do something or suggest deciding together.

pattern: verb stem + に行く / に来る / に帰る
name: Go, come, or return to do
meaning: Express movement undertaken for the purpose of an action.

name: Nominalization with こと
meaning: Turn an action or state into a noun-like idea or fact.

name: Nominalization with の
meaning: Turn an action or state into a noun-like event in conversational contexts.

pattern: dictionary form + ことができる
name: Ability
meaning: Express that someone can or is able to do an action.

name: Sometimes do
meaning: Express that an action happens sometimes.

name: Past experience
meaning: Express having done something before.

name: Representative actions
meaning: List examples of actions without implying a complete list or strict sequence.

name: Plan and intention
meaning: Express an intention or plan to do or not do something.

pattern: ～たほうがいい / ～ないほうがいい
name: Advice
meaning: Say that it would be better to do or not do something.

name: Formal obligation
meaning: Express that an action must or has to be done.

pattern: ～なくてはいけない / ～ないといけない
name: Obligation
meaning: Express that an action must or has to be done.

name: Casual obligation
meaning: Express must or have to with a conversational contraction.

name: If and when
meaning: Express a condition or an event after which another event occurs.

name: When
meaning: Locate an event at the time or occasion of another state or action.

pattern: dictionary form / noun の + 前に
name: Before
meaning: Place one event before another event or time.

pattern: past form / noun の + 後で
name: After
meaning: Place one event after another event or time.

name: Try doing
meaning: Try an action to see what it is like or what happens.

name: Completion or regret
meaning: Express complete finishing or an unintended and regrettable result.

name: While doing
meaning: Express two simultaneous actions performed by the same subject.

pattern: plain form + かもしれない
name: Possibility
meaning: Express that something might or may be the case.

name: Polite probability and confirmation
meaning: Express probability or seek confirmation with polite でしょう.

name: Plain probability and confirmation
meaning: Express probability or seek confirmation with plain だろう.

name: Appearance
meaning: Say that something looks or seems likely based on its appearance.

name: Hearsay
meaning: Report information heard from another source.

name: So that
meaning: Express a desired result or purpose that is not fully under direct control.

name: Automatic condition
meaning: Express a natural, habitual, or automatic result when a condition occurs.

name: I-adjectives
meaning: Recognize adjectives that conjugate through their final い.

name: I-adjective predicate
meaning: Use an i-adjective as a plain or polite non-past predicate.

name: I-adjective noun modification
meaning: Place an i-adjective directly before the noun it describes.

name: Negative i-adjectives
meaning: Negate an i-adjective in plain or polite style.

name: Past i-adjectives
meaning: Put an i-adjective in the past.

pattern: ～くなかった / ～くなかったです
name: Past-negative i-adjectives
meaning: Express that an i-adjective did not apply in the past.

name: I-adjective adverbs
meaning: Change an i-adjective into an adverb with く.

name: Irregular adjective いい
meaning: Conjugate いい using the よ stem in forms such as よくない and よかった.

name: Na-adjectives
meaning: Recognize adjectival nouns that use な before a noun and the copula as predicates.

name: Na-adjective predicate
meaning: Use a na-adjective as a plain or polite non-past predicate.

name: Na-adjective noun modification
meaning: Use な between a na-adjective and the noun it describes.

name: Negative na-adjectives
meaning: Negate a na-adjective in plain or polite style.

name: Past na-adjectives
meaning: Put a na-adjective in the past.

pattern: ～じゃなかった / ～ではありませんでした
name: Past-negative na-adjectives
meaning: Express that a na-adjective did not apply in the past.

name: Na-adjective adverbs
meaning: Change a na-adjective into an adverb with に.

name: Connecting descriptions
meaning: Join i-adjective, na-adjective, and noun descriptions.

name: Become with になる
meaning: Express a noun or na-adjective changing into a new state, role, or category.

name: Become with くなる
meaning: Express an i-adjective changing into a new degree or state.

name: Make or choose
meaning: Cause a change, make something a certain way, or decide on a choice.

name: Too much
meaning: Express that an action or quality exceeds an appropriate degree.

name: Want a thing
meaning: Express the speaker's desire to have a thing.

name: Likes and dislikes
meaning: Express liking or disliking a person, thing, or topic.

pattern: verb + のが好き / 嫌い
name: Like or dislike doing
meaning: Express a preference for or against an activity.

pattern: verb + のが上手 / 下手
name: Good or bad at doing
meaning: Describe skill or lack of skill at an activity.

name: Inanimate existence
meaning: State that an inanimate thing, event, or possession exists.

name: Animate existence
meaning: State that a person or animal exists or is present.

pattern: place に thing がある / いる
name: Something is in a place
meaning: Introduce an existing person or thing at a location.

pattern: thing は place にある / いる
name: Location of a known thing
meaning: State where a known person or thing is located.

pattern: noun の 上 / 下 / 中 / 前 / 後ろ / 隣 / 近く
name: Relative locations
meaning: Locate something relative to another noun using a positional noun.

pattern: person には thing がある
name: Possession with existence
meaning: Express having or possessing something through its existence.

name: Comparison baseline
meaning: Mark the item against which another item is compared.

pattern: A より B のほうが adjective
name: Comparative preference
meaning: Say that B is more adjective than A.

pattern: A と B とどちらが ...
name: Comparing two choices
meaning: Ask which of two items has more of a quality.

name: Superlative
meaning: Identify the item with the greatest degree within a group.

pattern: A と B は同じ
name: Same as
meaning: State that two things are the same in a relevant respect.

name: Counter system
meaning: Count people and things with a number followed by an appropriate counter.

name: General つ counter
meaning: Count many ordinary objects with the native Japanese general counter.

pattern: 人 / 枚 / 本 / 冊 / 台 / 匹 / 回 / 階 / 歳
name: Common classifiers
meaning: Use the common N5 counters for people, flat things, long things, books, machines, animals, occurrences, floors, and age.

name: How many
meaning: Ask for a quantity using 何 with the relevant counter.

name: Quantity placement
meaning: Place a counted quantity after its noun phrase and before the predicate.

name: Duration expressions
meaning: Use a duration directly before a predicate, normally without に.

pattern: 時 / 分 / 日 / 月 / 年 / 曜日
name: Clock and calendar expressions
meaning: Form and use times, dates, months, years, and days of the week.

pattern: A から B まで
name: From A to B
meaning: Express a spatial or temporal range with a start and end.

name: Already, anymore, or another
meaning: Mark completion, the end of a state with a negative, or one more item.

name: Still and not yet
meaning: Mark continuation or lack of expected completion.

pattern: とても / ちょっと / あまり～ない / 全然～ない
name: Basic degree adverbs
meaning: Express strong, slight, limited, or zero degree, including adverbs that conventionally pair with a negative.

pattern: いつも / よく / ときどき / あまり～ない / 全然～ない
name: Basic frequency adverbs
meaning: Express how often an action occurs, including frequencies that conventionally pair with a negative.

pattern: giver は recipient に thing をあげる
name: Give away from the speaker's side
meaning: Describe giving something to someone outside the speaker's in-group.

pattern: giver が speaker-side person に thing をくれる
name: Give toward the speaker
meaning: Describe someone giving something to the speaker or the speaker's in-group.

pattern: recipient は giver に / から thing をもらう
name: Receive
meaning: Describe receiving something from someone.

name: Do for someone
meaning: Describe performing an action as a benefit for someone else.

name: Someone does for me
meaning: Describe someone performing an action for the speaker or the speaker's in-group.

name: Have someone do
meaning: Describe receiving the benefit of another person's action.

pattern: これ / それ / あれ / どれ
name: Demonstrative pronouns
meaning: Refer to this, that, that over there, or which thing according to distance and discourse.

pattern: この / その / あの / どの
name: Demonstrative determiners
meaning: Specify this, that, that over there, or which noun.

pattern: ここ / そこ / あそこ / どこ
name: Place demonstratives
meaning: Refer to here, there, over there, or where.

pattern: こちら / そちら / あちら / どちら
name: Polite place, direction, and person demonstratives
meaning: Refer politely to a direction, place, side, or person.

pattern: こんな / そんな / あんな / どんな
name: Kind demonstratives
meaning: Refer to this kind, that kind, that kind over there, or what kind.

name: What
meaning: Ask the identity, content, or number of something.

name: Who
meaning: Ask about a person's identity.

name: When
meaning: Ask at what time or on what occasion something occurs.

pattern: なぜ / どうして / なんで
name: Why
meaning: Ask for a reason with different levels of formality and conversational tone.

name: How
meaning: Ask about condition, opinion, or manner.

name: How about
meaning: Ask for an opinion, condition, or reaction concerning a topic.

name: By what means
meaning: Ask how an action is performed or a result is achieved.

name: What kind
meaning: Ask about the kind or qualities of a noun.

name: Which
meaning: Ask which item among three or more possibilities.

name: How much
meaning: Ask a price or uncounted amount.

name: How many or how old
meaning: Ask a general count or age without a more specific counter.

name: Indefinite pronouns
meaning: Form words such as something, someone, and somewhere from a question word plus か.

name: Total and negative pronouns
meaning: Express everyone or everything in positive contexts and nobody or nothing with a negative predicate.

name: Say and be called
meaning: Report speech or state what a person or thing is called.

name: Think that
meaning: Express an opinion, judgment, or thought.

name: Whether or not
meaning: Embed a yes-or-no question inside a larger sentence.

name: Explanation and context
meaning: Present a situation as explanatory, contextual, or especially relevant.

name: Explanatory casual question
meaning: Ask for contextual explanation in conversational speech.

name: Way of doing
meaning: Form a noun meaning the way or method of doing an action.

name: In the middle of
meaning: Express that an activity or period is currently underway.

name: Together with
meaning: Emphasize doing something together with another person.
